Amsterdam.normalization: average-rank percentiles 0–100 among the same complete eligible Amsterdam neighbourhoods; income reversed; ties equal
Amsterdam.income_definition: O&S IHHINK_MED: median disposable household income, not equivalised/standardised; student households, institutional residents and households without income information are excluded.
Amsterdam.income_period_note: O&S confirmed on 27 October 2026: population at 1 January 2024 and household income over calendar year 2024. The 2024 figures are preliminary; definitive figures are expected sometime in 2027.
Amsterdam.income_rounding_note: Metadata describes rounding to hundreds; API values are not all multiples of 100. Published values retained unchanged.
Amsterdam.income_missing_note: O&S confirmed on 27 October 2026: after excluding student households, institutional residents and households without income information, areas with fewer than 100 remaining households receive no record. The current complete Wijk response has no record for BA and BB. No area-specific household counts were supplied.
Amsterdam.green_method: Amsterdam O&S 2025 ORPUBGROEN_P: public green area / total land area, joined by official Wijk code using geography 20220324. Source fraction multiplied by 100; deficit=100-share%. Private gardens and green roofs are not added. Does not measure access, distance or cooling performance
Amsterdam.heat_method: Median of finite band-1 summer LST composite pixels with band-2 valid_count>0, within each polygon and non-water WorldCover land mask; native 30 m raster
Amsterdam.raster_membership: pixel-centre inclusion, all_touched=False; WorldCover nearest-neighbour resampled only for thermal land mask
Amsterdam.coverage_note: Coverage thresholds are analyst choices, not provider rules. Coverage is spatial, not household coverage.
Amsterdam.landsat_limit: Existing project composite, JJA 2019–2023. Original scene selection/cloud-mask script is not supplied; zonal extraction is reproducible from the supplied composite.
Amsterdam.brussels: 145 Monitoring areas; 118 published income observations and 116 ranked neighbourhoods, independently using equivalised after-tax income; definitions differ.

income_confirmation.source_type: Personal correspondence retained in thesis records; not a public dataset
income_confirmation.confirmed_original_query: 418 Buurt records matched to 518 official polygons valid on 2022-03-24
income_confirmation.scope_limit: The correspondence confirmed the earlier match of 418 Buurt income records to 518 official Buurt polygons (100 absent records). The current model instead uses 110 Wijk polygons, with 108 income records; the earlier count must not be transferred to this geography.
income_confirmation.alternative_source: The respondent did not know another official table or period containing the missing values; this is not proof that none exists.

Brussels.normalization: average-rank percentiles 0–100 among the same complete eligible Brussels neighbourhoods; income reversed; ties equal
Brussels.income_definition: IBSA/Statbel indicator 2498: median equivalised after-tax income of residents, 2023. Household composition adjusted. Based on tax statistics and National Register; not administrative disposable income.
Brussels.income_scope_limit: Tax-exempt income such as child allowances and social integration income is not included. Some international-employment and property/capital income is absent or underestimated. See IBSA Panorama 2025 pp.50–54 for the definition and its limitations.
Brussels.income_comparability: Different definition from Amsterdam O&S IHHINK_MED (non-equivalised disposable household income). Each city is normalized and ranked separately; euros and scores must not be used as a cross-city income or performance comparison.
Brussels.income_missing_note: 27 of 145 source rows contain a dash. Preserve as null. The Monitoring geography includes 118 residential neighbourhoods and 27 other areas; do not infer zero income or zero need.
Brussels.green_method: Union of 1204 classified Public-ownership polygons in official public_green_spaces WFS; clip by neighbourhood, divide by total polygon area (including water). Private and mixed ownership excluded. Two unclassified polygons cause null green values in affected neighbourhoods; no imputation. Not accessibility or cooling performance.
Brussels.heat_method: Median of finite band-1 summer LST pixels with band-2 valid_count>0 inside the polygon and non-water WorldCover mask; native 30 m raster
Brussels.raster_membership: pixel-centre inclusion, all_touched=False; nearest-neighbour WorldCover thermal mask
Brussels.coverage_note: Thresholds are analyst choices. Spatial coverage is not household coverage.
Brussels.landsat_limit: Existing project composite JJA 2019–2023; original scene-selection/cloud-mask script is unavailable. Zonal extraction is reproducible from the supplied composite.
Brussels.green_denominator_limit: Brussels denominator is full neighbourhood polygon area; Amsterdam provider uses land area excluding water. Area shares are not directly comparable across cities.

validation_status: No predictive validation or scale-sensitivity metric is claimed. Each city has its own complete-observation universe and income definition.
